def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # The full 2-colored row/column is the barrier.
    barrier = None
    for r in range(h):
        if all(g[r][c] == 2 for c in range(w)):
            barrier = ('h', r)
            break
    if barrier is None:
        for c in range(w):
            if all(g[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h)):
                barrier = ('v', c)
                break
    if barrier is None:
        return g

    # The most frequent non-barrier color is the background; other pixels form the object.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v != 2)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    obj = [(r, c, g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
           if g[r][c] != 2 and g[r][c] != bg]
    if not obj:
        return g

    orient, b = barrier
    if orient == 'h':
        rows = [r for r, c, v in obj]
        if max(rows) < b:  # object above barrier; move down
            dr = b - 1 - max(rows)
            away_row = min(rows) + dr - 1
        elif min(rows) > b:  # object below barrier; move up
            dr = b + 1 - min(rows)
            away_row = max(rows) + dr + 1
        else:
            return g
        for r, c, v in obj:
            g[r][c] = bg
        for r, c, v in obj:
            g[r + dr][c] = v
        if 0 <= away_row < h:
            g[away_row] = [8] * w
    else:
        cols = [c for r, c, v in obj]
        if max(cols) < b:  # object left of barrier; move right
            dc = b - 1 - max(cols)
            away_col = min(cols) + dc - 1
        elif min(cols) > b:  # object right of barrier; move left
            dc = b + 1 - min(cols)
            away_col = max(cols) + dc + 1
        else:
            return g
        for r, c, v in obj:
            g[r][c] = bg
        for r, c, v in obj:
            g[r][c + dc] = v
        if 0 <= away_col < w:
            for r in range(h):
                g[r][away_col] = 8
    return g
PY
